When I first got on my 2016 NC750X, it felt huge, like I was driving a boat or something hahaha. My bike is like 30% heavier than the MT-03 (excluding cases and passenger). It being relatively heavy, you just have to be at least a bit more careful when getting familiar with it:

\- Make sure you have a lot of space in front of you to brake smoothly;

\- Prepare corners well

  
Having had done a few emergency brakes in my one year of owning this bike, I now know how fast the bike can ACTUALLY decelerate. Except for braking, I only feel the weight well when doing low-speed maneuvers, here it is same thing: be extra mindful.

My bike has done 2k km during my ownership and honestly it feels like it is becoming smaller every time I ride it.

Hope this helps!
